v1_compatibility: Existing v1 blocks remain valid; gallery and cover require v2. Existing v1 image attributes remain the original src/alt/title allowlist.

attributes_v2_additions.caption: optional plain text, UTF-8, max 4096 bytes

core/cover.children: 1..12 core/heading, core/paragraph, core/quote or core/button nodes only

rendering.image_text: Caption, alt and title are escaped as text/attributes.
rendering.responsive_styles: Only finite allowlisted class suffixes; no document-controlled style, CSS or HTML.
rendering.gallery: Fixed columns/alignment classes; grid collapses at tablet/mobile breakpoints.
rendering.cover: Escaped local image plus fixed overlay/content classes; no inline background URL or style attribute.
rendering.button_preview: Admin uses styled contenteditable only; does not navigate.
rendering.video_preview: Admin shows a local provider placeholder, no remote iframe. Public renderer retains the existing sandboxed YouTube/Vimeo embed.

patterns.storage: Built-in local insertion patterns only; no global pattern table or persistence.
patterns.ids: All pattern nodes use editor-generated IDs.
patterns.cover_hero: Intentionally invalid until the editor selects a local image; save stays blocked by normal validation until resolved.
